data.rationale: The proposal captures the right goal and step order (Bridges & Tunnels, then Tolls by vehicle, then choose vehicle type, then view rates), but it omits the concrete Menu → Agencies navigation, leaving the entry point vague ("menu or Fares & Tolls"), and it doesn't name the facility parameter, so an automation would need guesswork.
